profile.headline: Designer & Front End Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Graphic Designer with a demonstrated history of working in the graphic design and print production industry. Skilled in Logo Design, Brand Management, Digital Printing, and Adobe Creative Suite. Strong arts and design professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Digital Media Design from Baker College of Muskegon.
